content:
Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headline is the AirPods Pro 3 continuing at $50 off, but Amazon also has the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation hitting a near-month low today, with a chance to snag them for as low as $119. Amazon is also offering a brand new M5 MacBook Pro at $150 off, up to $400 off the M5 Pro/Max, and Apple's 24GB M5 MacBook Air at $150 off. Pair these deals with the Apple Watch Series 11 lineup all marked down by over $100, plus Hyper's latest 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure hitting a rare Amazon low of $80 off. See below for details.

AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation hit a new Amazon low in recent months, Pro 3 down $50, more from $99

This week brings a notable $50 price drop on Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3, good news for those who missed last month's Prime Day deals. Meanwhile the most affordable AirPods 4 continue to be marked down by nearly 25%, and this morning the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation dropped to its lowest price in several months at $144.99 with shipping included.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation $145 (originally $179)

As seen above, deals on the standard AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 are still going strong at Amazon, but if you want the lowest price on Apple's most affordable current active noise-cancelling earphones, the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation has hit its lowest price in three months.

Amazon is currently selling the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation for $144.99 with shipping included. Originally $179, that's a solid 20% off, and the lowest price we've found.

This price is also the lowest we've seen at Amazon since early to mid-March — the Active Noise Cancellation AirPods didn't drop below $149 during this year's Prime Day, and were selling for as much as $164 just last month.

Amazon offering $150 off M5 MacBook Pro base models, up to $400 off M5 Pro/Max

While pricing has gone up on the new M5, M5 Pro, and M5 Max lineup, Amazon is at least offering some deals if you're looking to buy right now. Up to $150 off on M5 base models, and some high-end 16-inch configurations are marked down by as much as $400.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (originally $2,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

The configurations below are now the deepest discounted models. $150 off on the M5, up to $300 off on the M5 Pro, and as much as $400 off on the M5 Max.

Yes, pricing has gone up, and less than a month ago these machines were cheaper than they are now, but that's just the way it is — if you're buying right now, you certainly don't want to pay more buying directly from Apple. Whether this pricing will drop back down, we don't know yet.

The more affordable M5 MacBook Air is the same situation — Amazon currently has several configurations $150 below new pricing:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

Amazon currently has Apple's 24GB M5 MacBook Air $150 below new pricing

Apple has raised prices, and there's no telling when the memory crisis will end. Given the situation, we wanted to remind everyone of the deals available now on 24GB M5 MacBook Air models, just in case things continue to worsen — Amazon has several configurations $150 below new pricing.

Amazon currently has the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 1TB of storage for just $1,649 with shipping included.

Apple's official site and other retailers are selling it for $1,799, but right now you can grab it in all three colors for $150 less.

Looking back at this recent 'RAM massacre' price hike wave, it's a mixed bag of emotions, but there's no turning back — the new suggested retail prices likely won't drop in the short term, and could even go up at any time, though nothing is certain. We might see these deals come and go daily, but right now it's still up in the air.

The same situation applies to these MacBook Pro models:

Upgrade your Apple Watch for summer, Series 11 all colors discounted to $299

Summer is approaching, and a wave of price cuts on the Apple Watch Series 11 has arrived, with the most affordable models getting a straight $100 off in cash. Whether you're prepping a summer birthday gift, a back-to-school present, or just looking to upgrade your own wearable setup, you can save some money.

There may be deeper discounts this fall, but if you want to buy the current Apple wrist computer right now, for whatever reason, you can already save quite a bit.

The most affordable 42mm Series 11 is now selling for $299 with shipping included. We already reported on this deal when it first appeared over the weekend, and now Amazon has all four case colors discounted: Jet Black, Rose Gold, Silver, and Space Gray.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $499)

This is the current Apple Watch with a $399 price tag, directly $100 off.

If you want the larger 46mm case, most (but not all) colors are $100 off. Keep an eye on the 46mm Cellular version below — that's $130 off:

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular from $399 (originally $529)

Hyper's latest 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure Mac version hits Amazon low at $80 off

If you're using a newer Mac and looking for a proper Thunderbolt 5 Dock to upgrade connectivity and support multiple displays, finding a good deal can really be a pain. I've personally run into quite a few display configuration issues, so this rare deal on the Hyper HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure is a nice one.

Amazon currently has the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure for just $319 with shipping included.

Originally $400, that's a solid $80 off, and the lowest price we've tracked at Amazon. This deal originally appeared during Prime Day as a Prime member exclusive, then returned to full price, and is now back.

It's still not cheap, but when it comes to 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 Docks, this is a brand that truly supports Mac, giving you their latest and greatest model, featuring 'triple high-resolution display support for Windows PCs and MacBook Pro M5 Pro/Max laptops'.

Supports up to three 4K 60Hz displays or one 8K 144Hz display, offering 'smooth motion and sharp detail'. Other macOS and Chrome OS devices support up to two extended displays only.

Built-in M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 and Gen 3 slots let you expand storage in an extremely elegant and clean way while massively expanding connectivity options:

  • 2x Thunderbolt 5 downstream
  • 3x USB-A (10Gbps)
  • RJ-45 2.5Gbps Ethernet
  • 3.5mm audio
  • Nano + standard security lock slot
  • 140W power passthrough
  • DC 20V power supply

Limited time deal: Nomad 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger drops another 30%, Cosmic Orange hits new historical low

Nomad's anniversary sale for 2026 is heating up this week, but they've again dropped the price on their latest 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger. Black and white models of this premium metal and glass charger are now 30% off, and the brand new Cosmic Orange has hit a new historical low.

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger $90 (originally $129) Black or White
  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger $111 (originally $139) Brand new Cosmic Orange

The 3-in-1 25W Stand One Max is still holding its launch 20% discount, but Nomad appears to have launched the typical daily limited deal on the 2-in-1 model — 20% off started just yesterday.

Beyond the further discount on black and white, the brand new Cosmic Orange colorway is discounted 20% for the first time, hitting a new historical low.

Anker 2026 summer sale starts from $8: Smart display chargers, 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe stands, hubs, car mounts, and more

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • SSD prices are painfully high right now, but this 1TB pocket drive is 40% off today at $180
  • Satechi anodized aluminum Slim EX wireless mouse with metal scroll wheel drops to $24
  • ASUS's newly launched 27-inch ProArt 4K 240Hz QD-OLED professional-grade display hits new low at $300 off
  • UGREEN NeoDrive Go 1TB USB4 SSD with built-in 40Gb/s cable hits new low $300 (originally $500)
  • Anker 10-port slim plug power strip drops to $20 at Amazon
  • UGREEN 14th anniversary sale officially launched, deals from $7: Buy one get one half off, brand new historical lows, and more
  • This 2-pack retractable USB-C cables now from just $7.50 each (multiple colors available)
  • Heads up! Lexar's $480 2TB iPhone pocket SSD is $220 off today

Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro all colors $220 off, some up to $449 off

We've been tracking some decent deals on Amazon's renewed iPhone 17 Pro lineup, but the discounts on their highest quality Renewed Premium tier hadn't been particularly compelling — until now. All three colors of the latest iPhone 17 Pro are tracked at up to $220 below new pricing.

All below are sold and shipped directly by Amazon (not third-party sellers), at the Renewed Premium tier — Amazon's highest quality refurbished units, with a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and 'over 90% original battery life'.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (new originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (new originally $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (new originally $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (new originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (new originally $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (new originally $1,299)

The real focus this time is the 1TB model, $220 cheaper than buying a brand new unlocked 17 Pro directly from Apple. The 512GB models are $100 off, but for some that may not be enough incentive to forgo buying new.

Nonetheless, these are among the best deals we've tracked on brand new Amazon Renewed Premium units, but you can still snag 'Excellent' tier refurbished units at Amazon for even less — the main differences being only a 90-day Amazon Renewed warranty and battery capacity at 'over 80% of original':

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (new originally $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,139 (new originally $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (new originally $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,240 (new originally $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,263 (new originally $1,499)

Woot has these 17 Pro Max models up to $49 off — 'mint condition, never touched by customers' with 'test sticker showing 100% battery life' and a fancy custom black packaging box.

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Still going: Anker 3-port 160W smart display charger back at Prime Day price (33% off), more from $8
